note: Verification-words goldens. Derivation: SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key, first 55 bits, five 11-bit BIP39 English indices, most-significant group first. Reference implementation: src/rine/auth/service.py. Regenerate with rine-sdk/tests/fixtures/generate_verification_words_vectors.py.

vectors.name: baseline-one-bit
vectors.description: The baseline key with the low bit of its last byte flipped. Its words must differ from the baseline's — that is the whole point of showing them to an operator.

vectors.name: baseline-padded-x
vectors.description: The baseline key whose `x` carries explicit base64url padding. Decodes to the same 32 bytes, so it must produce the same words.
